title: One-Click Inward GRN Receipt against PO

intro.title: PO-to-GRN Inward Receipt
intro.subtitle: Convert approved Purchase Orders to inward bills with 1-click prefill, delivery matching, and batch registration

narration.text: Welcome to Phase 5, Part 5: One-Click Inward GRN Receipt against a Purchase Order. Converting approved POs directly into GRNs eliminates duplicate data entry and enforces delivery matching.
On the Purchase Order Details screen, review your approved order. When the distributor delivers the goods, click Receive GRN.
Notice the banner: Receiving goods against PO. The supplier, ordered medicines, quantities, and negotiated rates are loaded automatically.
Enter the distributor's physical invoice number, and type the received Batch Numbers and Expiry Dates directly into each pre-filled row.
Save the inward bill. The purchase order automatically marks as Received, updating supplier ledger payables and replenishing warehouse stock batches.

outro.takeaway: PO-to-GRN Conversion: Convert approved purchase orders to inward bills with 1 click, capture physical batch lots, and update inventory effortlessly.
